description: [$x402 pay-per-call] Looks up ASN, prefix, country, and organization for an IP or hostname via Team Cymru.

host.description: Hostname or IPv4 address. Hostnames resolve via A record first.

x_payment.description: Optional. Signed x402 payment header (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / X-PAYMENT) from the caller. If omitted, returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements.

name: net_tools_asn_lookup
